members.name: add_obj
members.summary: Base method for adding new object to the clothing of this human.
members.description:
The object can sit on the human in any pose and with any body shape. Its
pose and the body shape are taken out so it fits the unmodified body,
corrective shapekeys are added, it is weight painted and added to the
armature. On this human it keeps looking the way it did.

params.description: Object you want to add to the clothing.

params.description: Type of clothing as string, defines what kind of corrective shapekeys will be added.

params.description: Whether to recalculate weights of the vertex groups. Only disable if you manually set the weights.

params.name: context
params.description: Blender context. bpy.context if not provided.

params.name: progress
params.description: Called with a fraction from 0 to 1 as the conversion advances, for a progress indicator.

returns.description: How the weights were computed. "closest_point" means the weight solver failed and the weights will need manual cleanup.

members.name: add_obj_steps
members.summary: The work of `add_obj` as resumable steps, see `HumGen3D.common.progress`.
members.description:
Yields the fraction of the work that is done. The object is only changed
in the last step, so a generator that is closed early leaves it as it is.

returns.description: How the weights were computed, see `add_obj`.

members.name: deform_cloth_to_human
members.summary: Deforms the cloth object to the shape of the active HumGen human.
members.description:
Mainly meant for internal use, but might be useful. Expects the base
shape of the passed cloth_obj to fit a standard HG human with no
adjustments. Stores the shape that fits the current body proportions and
height of the human in the "Body Proportions" shape key.

See `HumGen3D.human.clothing.garment_fit` for the vertex group and custom
properties a clothing object can use to steer how loosely it is fitted.
